title: Velocity Slate: route + model performance UX with quantile chart specs
creator: Sofia Alvarez
description: Design a compact, vertically scalable performance surface ("Velocity Slate") optimized for per-route and per-model observability in the Redwood Console. Focus on latency quantiles, throughput trends, token flow (prefix vs generated), and cost attribution layers that fold into rollout controls. Deliverables: high-fidelity Figma prototype, chart spec doc for engineering (series, downsampling rules, zoom behavior), accessibility notes, and handoff token/legend assets.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype demonstrates default layout for 1 model route + ability to switch to 4-up small multiples
Chart spec includes data schema for p50/p90/p95 lines, median band, and percentile ribbon implementation guidance
Throughput heatmap and token waterfall have defined binning strategy and default window options (5m/1h/24h)
Cost attribution overlay maps tokens->cost using per-model unit-cost and shows per-route impact on charts
Rollout widget integrates with existing rollout API (canary + auto-fallback) and surfaces performance deltas by percentiles
comments: 2025-02-14 Sofia Alvarez: Initial wireframe review with PM. PM asked for stronger emphasis on P95 as primary SLO signal and a compact small-multiple mode for multi-route comparison.
2025-02-18 Maya Chen: Implemented quantile ribbon (p25-p75) + p50/p90/p95 lines in prototype; added toggle to hide ribbons for tablet mode.
2025-02-22 Design critique: UX team suggested swapping top-left KPI to 'Cost per 1k tokens' instead of raw tokens to match billing mental model.
2025-02-26 Engineering sync (Andre Patel): clarified data availability: runtime emits p50/p90/p95 and raw token counts per request. Agreed on client-side rolling-window aggregation for heatmap bins.

2025-03-01 Usability test (5 participants): participants could identify perf regressions in 2/3 scenarios; confusion around ribbon opacity for low-traffic routes noted — lowered ribbon opacity and added tooltip explanation.
2025-03-03 PM review (Liam O'Connor): green light for engineering handoff pending one change: add 'compare baseline' toggle that overlays previous deployment percentiles for rollout evaluation.
